subclassFeature.name: Corpswrought Creature
entries: You have constructed a companion from scavenged body parts and brought it to life with your occult magic: a corpswrought creature. The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands.

In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take another action.

If your corpswrought creature has died within the last hour, you can use your healer's kit as an action to revive it, provided you are within 5 feet of it and you expend an apothecary spell slot. The corpswrought companion returns to life after 1 minute with all its hit points restored.

At the end of a long rest, you can create a new corpswrought creature if you have your healer's kit with you and access to suitable materials. If you already have a corpswrought creature from this feature, the first one immediately perishes. The creature also perishes if you die.

foundryEffects.name: I Can't Stop the Monster I Created

subclassFeature.name: Bodyguard
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of your corpsewrought creature makes an attack against you, it can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature. In addition, your corpsewrought creature's slam attack counts as magical for the purpose of ivercoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
In addition you can cast {@spell animate dead} once using an Apothecary spell slot. Once you do, you can't cast the spell again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Reanimated Head
entries: You have reanimated the head of a dead humanoid creature which now serves you in your studies. You may use the head as a spellcasting focus. The head speaks Common and one other language of your choice.

Whenever you make an Intelligence ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Additionally, you gain proficiency in the Arcana and Investigation skills.
You can use the head to cast {@spell speak with dead} without expending a spell slot. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Behold My Creation
entries: Your corpswrought creature's size increases to Large, and its speed increases to 40 feet.

When your corpswrought creature hits a creature with a melee attack, it can immediately make a grapple attempt against the target. The DC to escape this grapple is equal to 8 + the corpswrought creature's Strength modifier (+4) + your proficiency bonus.

subclassFeature.name: Berserk Fury
entries: When you command your corpswrought creature to take the Attack action, the creature can make two attacks.

subclassFeature.name: I Can't Stop the Monster I Created
entries: Your corpswrought creature increases in size to Huge, gains a reach of 10 feet, and its speed increases to 50 feet. Its slam attack deals an additional {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage.
Additionally, the weight your corpswrought creature can push or lift is doubled.

item.name: Acidic Grip
entries: As an action, make a melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage.

spell.name: Acid Burn
entries: You magically produce a spray of acidic formula in a 15-foot cone in front of you. All creatures in the cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} acid damage
This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Bacterial Barrage
entries: You attack a creature in range with a quick spreading infection that takes advantage of existing conditions. Make a ranged spell attack against a target, on a hit the infection does {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage to the target. If the target is suffering from the {@condition Poisoned} condition or a disease, it instead takes {@damage 1d12} necrotik damage.
The spell's damage increases by one die when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d8} or {@dice 2d12}), 11th level ({@dice 3d8} or {@dice 3d12}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d8} or {@dice 4d12}).

scalingLevelDice.label: necrotic damage to {@condition Poisoned} or affected by Disease

spell.name: Poison Needle
entries: You launch a conjured dart coated with lethal poison at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} poison damage.

If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.
This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d10} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d10}), 11th level ({@dice 3d10}) and 17th level ({@dice 4d10}).

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned for 1 hour.

foundryEffects.name: Paralyzed
foundryEffects.description: While the creature is poisoned it is paralyzed.

spell.name: Acrid Orb

components.m: a vial of stoamch acid and a pinch of sulfate

entries: You create an orb of acid gel and fling it at once creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit the target takes {@damage 1d12+1} acid damage, Whether the attack hits or misses the orb explodes. The target and each creature within 5-foot cube of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} acid damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the exploding acid damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Envenom
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range to inflict with a magical poison. The target takes {@damage 2d4} poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, it becomes {@condition Poisoned} for the spell's duration.

While {@condition Poisoned} in this way, the target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. It takes {@damage 2d4} poison damage on a failed saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
A lesser restoration on the target ends this spell early

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each level above 1st.

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned for 1 minute, and takes 2d4 poison damage every turn until the spell ends or it succeeds a Constitution saving throw.

spell.name: Infect
entries: You inflict a creature you can see within range with a magical disease. At the start of each of the target's turns, it must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes  {@damage 1d12} necrotic damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one. If a target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends.
A lesser restoration spell cast on the target ends this spell early.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d12|1,3,5,7,9|1d12}

foundryEffects.name: Magical Disease
foundryEffects.description: At the start of each of the creature's turns, it must makes a Constitution saving throw. THe creature takes 1d12 necrotic damage on a failed save or half on a successful one. The effet ends if the target succeeds three saving throws.

spell.name: Stream of Consumption
entries: For the spell's duration, your tongue becomes an elongated tether of necrotic green energy you can use to drink the vitality of other creatures. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}, and you regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} + your spellcasting ability modifier

On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to target the same creature or a different one, but can't target a creature again if it has succeeded on a saving throw against this casting of stream of consumption.

foundryEffects.name: Exhaustion
foundryEffects.description: The creature suffers one level of exhasution.

spell.name: Toxic Shield
entries: You gain resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against being poisoned for the duration. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with melee attack, the shield sprays them with poison, dealing {@damage 1d8} poison damage to the attacker.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the poison damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|1,3,5,7,9|1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

foundryEffects.name: Poison Resistance
foundryEffects.description: The creature has resistnace to poison while the spell is active.

spell.name: Biohazard
entries: You coat a 15-foot cube with toxic sludge for the spell's duration. The area is difficult terrain and filled with dangerous fumes. A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} poison damage and is {@condition Poisoned} until the start of its next turn. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Caustic Grip
entries: For the spell's duration, your hand secretes sticky burning acid which you can use to hold a creature in a painful clutch. When you cast this spell, and as an action on your turn until the spell ends, you can make a melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, you deal {@damage 4d4} acid damage to the target, and the creature is {@condition restrained} in your acidic grip until the end of your next turn. You can attack the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no logner affected by the spell.

A creature {@condition restrained} by your grip can use its action to make a Strenght check against you spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer {@condition restrained}. Each time a creature ends its turn {@condition restrained}. Each time a creature ends its turn {@condition restrained} by this spell it takes and additional {@damage 4d4} acid damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|2-9|2d4} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Grasping Ghost

components.m: a finger bone and a scrap of fabric

entries: A flock of floating spectral hands appear and grasp a target you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw. A target takes {@damage 3d8} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

In addition, on a failed saving throw the ghostly hands {@condition grapple} the target until the end of your next turn, and immediately move the target up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice (but not upward). On its turn, the creature can use an action to attempt to escape the grapple by making a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, the {@condition grappled} ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each level above 2nd.

foundryEffects.name: Grappled
foundryEffects.description: The creature is grappled until the end of the casters nex turn.

spell.name: Invigorate

components.m: a syringe and a blood sample

entries: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target gains {@dice 10} temporary hit points.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3nd level or higher, the temporary hit points increases by 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Ocular Necrosis
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against the creature you can see in range. If you hit, you wrack the creature with deadly toxin that causes their eyes to bleed. The creature takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the necrotic damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Corrosive Blast
entries: A spew of acrid chemicals erupts form the hands. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 10d4} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The acid destroys any object made of organic materials in the spell's area. A creature killed by this spell has its flesh entirely dissolved, leaving behind only a corroded skeleton.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the acid damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d4|3-9|2d4} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Fetid Blade

components.m: a drop of acid and a pinch of iron dust

entries: You coat your weapon you touch in an acidic substance. Until the spell ends, weapon attacks made with it deal an extra {@damage 2d4} acid damage on a hit. If the weapon isn't already magic weapon, it becomes one for the duration.
In addition, a creature hit with melee attacks using the weapon must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it becomes {@condition poisoned} until the end of the attacker's next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the acid damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|3-9|1d4} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Pestilence
entries: You infect up to three creatures you can see within range with a magic disease. At the start of each of the target's turns, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes {@damage 3d6} necrotic damage and gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. If a target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends for that creature.
A {@spell lesser restoration} spell cast on a target ends this spell early for that creature.

foundryEffects.name: Magical Disease
foundryEffects.description: At the start of each of the creature's turns, it must makes a Constitution saving throw. THe creature takes 3d6 necrotic damage on a failed save and one level of exhaustion. The effet ends if the target succeeds a saving throws.

spell.name: Purge Contamination

components.m: 100gp of alchemical fluids or holy water, which the spell consumes

entries: You apply alchemical fluids or holy water to a contaminated humanoid creature while reciting an exacting magical chant which expels eldritch contaminants from its body. When you finish casting the spell, all contamination levels and mutations are removed from the creature. It then gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} for each contamination level removed with this spell.

spell.name: Tranquilizing Toxin
entries: One target you choose within range must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 8d6} poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} until the end of your next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way the target is also {@condition stunned}. On a successful saving throw, the target takes half damage and is not {@condition poisoned}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the poison damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

foundryEffects.name: Tranquilizing Toxin
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned until the end of the casters next turn.

foundryEffects.name: Tranquilizing Toxin Stun
foundryEffects.description: While the creature is poisoned by Tranquilizing Toxin its stunned.

spell.name: Venomous Aura

components.m: scales or fangs of a venomous snake

entries: You emit a baleful aura which disorients creatures who approach you. Any creature that starts their turn within 10 feet of you are {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn.

spell.name: Blood Worm
entries: You infect a creature you can see within range with magical disease in the form of a malignant parasite. Once per turn when a creature hits the infected target with a weapon attack, the target deals an additional {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage, and the attacker regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt. Each time the infected target takes this necrotic damage, it makes a Constitution saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the necrotic damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|4-9|1d6} for each slot level above 4th.

foundryEffects.name: Blood Worm Disease
foundryEffects.description: Once per turn when the creature is attackd, it takes additional necrotic damage and the attacker heals for that much hit points. Ecuh time the creature takes damage, make a Constitution saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw sicceeds the spell ends.

spell.name: Corpse Explosion
entries: You cause the triggering creature's body to explode in a violent shower of gore and infected flesh. Creatures within a 10-foot cube of a point centered on the triggering creature's body take {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage and {@damage 4d8} acid damage, or half as much damage on a successful Dexterity saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8;4d8|4-9|1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Corrupting Spores
entries: A small patch of three poison mushrooms magically sprout in a 5-foot square that you can see within range. The mushrooms emit toxic spores, and any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the mushroom patch must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the creature takes {@damage 1d8} poison damage for each mushroom in the patch and is is {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.
Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on you turn to cause an additional mushroom to sprout within the patch.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, one aditional mushroom sprouts with the inital patch for each slot above 4th.

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Last Rites

components.m: a small piece of brass, a rose petal, and a drop of holy water.

entries: You target a creature you can see within range with a beam of holy light that shines down upon them. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. The target takes {@damage 8d8} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This spell has no effect on celestials or constructs.

If you target and undead, or fiend, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and the spell deals maximum damage to it. If an undead or fiend is reduced to 0 hit points by this spell, it dies and its body is reduced to ash.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature within 30 feet of each other for each spell level for each level above 5th.

spell.name: Poison Wave

components.m: a withered root and a drop of vinegar

entries: A wave of poisonous fumes emanates form you. Creatures within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, each creature takes {@damage 4d12} poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of your next turn. On a Successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage and does not, become {@condition poisoned}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d12|4-9|1d12} for each slot level above 4th.

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Vitriol Ichor

components.m: a vial of nitric acid and a flask of water

entries: Choose a creature within range tha has natural armor or is wearing armor. You magically cause the creature's natural or manufactured armor to become corroded and brittle for the spell's duration. While its armor is corroded, the creatures's AC becomes 10 + the creatures Dexterity modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each level above 5th.

spell.name: Acid Rain

components.m: pinch of sulfur and ground cloal

entries: Until the spell ends, acid rain falls in a 40-foot radius cylinder centered on a point you choose within range. The area is lightly obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

Chemical pools accumulate on the ground in the area, making it difficult terrain. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes {@damage 3d6} acid damage and must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it falls {@condition prone}, in the pools, taking and additional {@damage 3d6} acid damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the acid damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6;3d6|5-9|1d6} for each slot level above 5th.

foundryEffects.name: Prone
foundryEffects.description: The creature is prone

spell.name: Nerve Gas

components.m: samples of phosphate and chlorine mixees with a drop of alcohol

entries: You create a 10-foot-radius sphere of toxic fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. The fog's area is heavily obscured

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make an Intelligence saving throw, On a failed saving throw, the creature takes {@damage 3d6} psychic damage and becomes {@condition stunned} until the start of its next turn. On a Successful saving throw, the creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breath.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|5-9|1d6} for each slot level above 5th.

foundryEffects.name: Stunned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is stunned until the start of its next turn.

spell.name: Septic Shock
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range that doesn't have all its hit points. You infect the target's wounds with putrefying bacteria. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. If it has less than half its maximum hit points remaining, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 10d8} necrotic damage and gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and does not gain {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and does not gain any {@condition exhaustion} levels.

foundryEffects.name: Exhaustion
foundryEffects.description: The creature suffers one level of exhasution.

spell.name: Toxic Barrage
entries: You create four rays of pure poison and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several.

Make a ranged attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} poison damage. If a target is hit by one or more of these rays, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While poisoned the way, the target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each if its turns. On a success. it is no longer poisoned.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 5th.

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned for one minute. The creature can repeat the Constitution saving throw at then end of each of its turns.

spell.name: Mephitic Vapors
entries: You douse a 20-foot radius area centered on a point you can see within range with acrid slime, which remains for the spell's duration. The area becomes difficult terrain, and any creature wholly within the area is blinded and can't  take reactions. A creature who starts its turn in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d8} poison damage and {@damage 2d8} acid damage and gain one level of exhaustion.

foundryEffects.name: Blinded
foundryEffects.description: The creature is Blinded until standing in the area.

foundryEffects.name: Exhaustion
foundryEffects.description: The creature suffers one level of exhasution.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the exploding acid damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8;2d8|6-9|1d8} for each slot level above 6th.

spell.name: Vile Necrosis
entries: You point your finger towards a creature within range, projecting a pale green beam of debilitating energy at them. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 12d6} necrotic damage, and it becomes weakened. While weakened by this spell, a target deals half damage with weapon attacks and spells.
A weakened target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the weakness ends.

foundryEffects.name: Weakened — Vile Necrosis
foundryEffects.description: While weakened by Vile Necrosis, this creature deals half damage with weapon attacks and spells. The creature can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the weakness on a successful save.

spell.name: Grievous Wounds
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. You momentarily strip the target's physiology of all resilience, enough that a mere scratch can become a terrible injury. Until the end of your next turn, the target loses any damage resistance or immunities, becomes vulnerable to all damage, and makes all its saving throws with disadvantage.

foundryEffects.name: Grievous Wounds
foundryEffects.description: Until the end of your next turn, this creature loses all damage resistances and immunities, becomes vulnerable to all damage, and makes all saving throws with disadvantage.

spell.name: Miasma
entries: You Create a wall of sickly, yellowish green, toxin fumes on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 foot long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The Wall is opaque and lasts far the duration.
While the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d4} acid damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, emits toxic fumes. It deals {@damage 8d8} poison damage to each creature that ends its turn within 30 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn. The other side of the wall deals no damage.
A creature who takes poison from the wall make a Constitution saving throw or become poisoned from the duration of the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|7-9|2d8} for each slot level above 7th.

foundryEffects.name: Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned.

spell.name: Breath of Nightshade

components.m: A pair of deadly nighshade flowers

entries: You exhale a 60-foot-cone of lethal poison. Each creature in the area when you cast the spell must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} by this spell, the creature is paralyzed.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage.

foundryEffects.name: Breath of Nightshade Poisoned
foundryEffects.description: The creature is poisoned for 1 hour.

foundryEffects.name: Paralized
foundryEffects.description: The creature is paralyzed while Poisoned by Breath of Nightshade.

spell.name: Plague Wind
entries: You summon a rolling wind of flesh devouring disease and excruciating blood boiling fumes that sweep over the area emanating from you in a 120-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw a creature takes {@damage 5d8} poison damage and {@damage 5d8} necrotic damage or half as much damage on a success. After taking this damage, any affected creature with 25 hit points or fewer remaining immediately dies and is reduced to a weathered skeleton as their flesh and soft tissue blows off like ash.

spell.name: Pandemic

components.m: the fetid corpse of a plage rat

entries: You infect one creature you can see within a range with deadly and highly infectious disease which lasts until it is cured by greater restoration, heal or wish. Other spells and magical effect which remove diseases fail to cure the infection caused by this spell.

While infected, a creature must make a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns, On a failed saving throw, it takes {@damage 10d8} necrotic damage and becomes incapacitated until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is not incapacitated. An infected creature must make the saving throw at the start of each of its turns until it dies or is cured.
A creature who starts its turn within 10 feet of a creature infected by this spell must make a Constitution saving throw, In a failed saving throw, that creature contracts the infection.
When you cast the spell, you can choose yourself and up to eight other creatures to be uaffected by the infection caused by this casting of the spell.

spell.name: Touch of Death
entries: Make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 200} poison damage. This damage ignores any resistance or immunity the creature has to poison damage, and can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

The potent poison lingers in the targets body and pulls it towards death. A target reduced to zero hit points by this poison damage automatically fails death saving throws until it finishes a long rest. A heal or greater restoration spell cast on the target also ends this effect.

optionalfeature.name: Acquired Tolerance
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}, and you have {@variantrule resistance|XPHB} against poison damage.
In addition, you automatically succeed on saving throws against your own apothecary spells, and never rake damage from your own apothecary spells.

optionalfeature.name: Adrenaline Surge
entries: A creature at 0 hit points who regains hit points from a spell you cast using an apothecary spell slot gains {@variantrule resistance|XPHB} to all damage and has advantage on saving throws until the end of its next turn. It gains advantage on the first attack roll it makes on its next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Anatomical Precision
entries: When you make a weapon attack, you can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls.

optionalfeature.name: Anesthesiology
entries: You can cast {@spell hold person} without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. You must finish a long rest before you can use this theory on the same creature again.

optionalfeature.name: Bedside Manner
entries: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Persuasion skills. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of these skills.

optionalfeature.name: Caustic Formulae
entries: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature or object with an apothecary spell, you can expend an apothecary spell slot to deal {@damage 2d4} extra acid damage to that target, plus another {@damage 2d4} per level of the spell slot.

activation.condition: Once per turn when you deal damage with an apothecary spell.

description.chatFlavor: Deal extra acid damage to the creature or object damaged by your apothecary spell.

optionalfeature.name: Clinical Conditioning
entries: You gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Combat Medic
entries: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and shields.

optionalfeature.name: Corrosive Compound
entries: When you deal poison damage with your apothecary spells, you can choose to deal half the spell's damage as poison damage and half the spell's damage as acid damage instead.

optionalfeature.name: Cosmetic Surgery
entries: You can spend 8 hours performing an occult surgical procedure upon a willing creature, permanently transforming its appearance. You decide what the creature looks like, including facial features, the sound of its voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics, but none of its game statistics change. You can't alter the size of a creature, and its basic shape stays the same. The resulting transformation is non-magical, however, a greater restoration spell or similar magic cast upon the creature can restore it to its original appearance.

optionalfeature.name: Critical Condition
entries: When a creature rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw made against one of your apothecary spells that deals damage, roll all of the spell's damage dice twice and add them together. Then add any relevant modifiers as normal to determine the damage that creature takes from the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Diagnosis
entries: You can take the Help action as a bonus action on your turn.

optionalfeature.name: Doctor's Note
entries: You can cast {@spell sending} at-will. You must finish a long rest before you can use this theory to contact the same creature again.

optionalfeature.name: Double Dose
entries: When you cast an apothecary spell using an apothecary spell slot that targets a single creature and restores hit points to that creature, you can target an additional creature within range.

optionalfeature.name: Extracurricular Research
entries: You learn two additional cantrips of your choice from any class's spell list. These cantrips become apothecary cantrips for you.

optionalfeature.name: Inoculation
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced. In addition, you are immune to diseases.

optionalfeature.name: Interdisciplinary Practice
entries: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Laboratory Assistant
entries: You learn the spell {@spell find familiar}, and always have this spell prepared. It doesn't count against the number of apothecary spells you can prepare.

optionalfeature.name: Liability Insurance
entries: You can cast {@spell contingency } once on yourself without material components. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Medical Expertise
entries: You gain proficiency in the Medicine and Nature skills. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of these skills.

optionalfeature.name: Medical Lexicon
entries: You learn six languages of your choice. You can cast {@spell detect poison and disease} at will.

optionalfeature.name: Nerve Agent
entries: When you deal poison damage with your apothecary spells, you can choose to deal psychic damage instead.

optionalfeature.name: Noxious Blood
entries: When a creature hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet of you, it takes poison damage equal to {@damage 1d6} + your Intelligence modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Pharmacology
entries: When you cast a spell using an apothecary spell slot or your Greater Formula feature which restores hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Physiological Analysis
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its physiology. The Game Master reveals to you two of the following characteristics of your choice: Any one ability score; Armor Class; Current hit points; Resistances (if any); Immunities (if any); Vulnerabilities (if any). Alternatively, you can spend 1 minute observing a corpse. After 1 minute, you determine the cause of death.

optionalfeature.name: Practical Resuscitation
entries: When you cast a spell that has the sole effect of restoring a creature to life (but not undeath), such as {@spell raise dead}, you don't need material components to cast the spell if the creature has died within the past hour.

optionalfeature.name: Putrefaction
entries: Your apothecary spells and abilities ignore undead creatures' resistance or immunity to poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition.

optionalfeature.name: Rapid Response
entries: When you cast an apothecary spell that restores hit points to a creature, before or after casting the spell, you can move your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Routine Procedure
entries: You can cast {@spell lesser restoration} at-will without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Stolen Secrets
entries: You learn one spell from any class's spell list. It must be of a level for which you have apothecary spell slots or lower. The spell is treated as an apothecary spell for you, and doesn't count against the number of apothecary spells you know.

optionalfeature.name: Subject Preparation
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against an apothecary spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Surgeon's Instinct
entries: You have blindsight out to a range of 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Surgical Strikes
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.

optionalfeature.name: Toxicology
entries: You add your Intelligence modifier to the damage rolls of spells that deal poison damage.

optionalfeature.name: Triage
entries: You learn the {@spell spare the dying} cantrip if you don't know it already. When you cast this cantrip, it has a range of 60 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Unfailing Focus
entries: When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on an apothecary spell, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

description.chatFlavor: After failing a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on an Apothecary spell, use Unfailing Focus to succeed instead.

optionalfeature.name: Venomous Instruments
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes extra poison damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Virulence
entries: When you roll a 1 on a damage die for an apothecary spell that deals poison damage, you can reroll the die. You must use the new result, even if the new roll is a 1.

optionalfeature.name: Vital Signs
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw or death saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the creature's roll, potentially turning a failure into a success. You must finish a short rest before you can use this theory on the same creature again.

description.chatFlavor: Add your Intelligence modifier to the target's failed saving throw or death saving throw.

optionalfeature.name: Vivisection
entries: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

optionalfeature.name: Greater Formula (6th)
entries: Choose a 6th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spell 7th
entries: Choose a 7th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Kurva
entries: Choose a 7th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Anyád
entries: Choose a 7th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spell 8th
entries: Choose an 8th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spell 9th
entries: Choose a 9th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: SPell 6th
entries: Choose an additional 6th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spell 7th
entries: Choose an additional 7th-level Apothecary spell as a Greater Formula. Cast it once without a spell slot per long rest.
